statReproductions.virtual: ENOTSUP: stat precision is only supported for epoch timestamps
ENOTSUP: stat precision is only supported for epoch timestamps

calibration: MemoryFS mkdir default is 0777, not assumed 0755; test fixture now explicitly supplies 0755.
MemoryFS enforces owner bits, but does not model host uid/group identity; no claim of absent enforcement.
Mount backing fixture must start empty to avoid an unrelated extra work child.
Darwin symlink initial modes differ from MemoryFS; controlled native lchmod sets fixture links to 0777 before comparing full modes.
Mode-fuzz final byte reads restore 0600 after capturing all mode comparisons.
